# Kcs capture in the flow

`customer_support.df.self_service_deflection.kcs_capture_in_the_flow` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **decision_framework**

> Knowledge-Centered Service — capture the answer while solving the case, review by usage rather than by calendar, and make the person who used an article the person who fixes it.

Answers written later, by people who did not solve the case, describe the product rather than the problem. Usage-driven review also concentrates maintenance where decay actually costs something instead of spreading it evenly over content nobody reads.
